title: Lecture Circuit 2
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Lecture Circuit 2', Michael discusses his lecture circuit and plans to confront Holly in Nashua for closure. The episode features office celebrations, conflicts, and revelations about relationships and personal ambitions.

main_threads.thread: Michael's lecture circuit and his plans to confront Holly

evidence.snippet: Michael: I am on a lecture circuit. I'm goin' around to all the branches, and I'm telling them my secret recipe for success.
Pam: So, detour. We're now adding Nashua to the Lecture Circuit so Michael can confront Holly and get some closure.

character_highlights.what_changes: Expresses his plans to confront Holly and becomes upset over her departure and new relationship.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I am on a lecture circuit. I'm goin' around to all the branches, and I'm telling them my secret recipe for success.

Michael: I can't do the presentation, I can't- … just… oh… thinking about seeing him… and… thinking about… him getting to hold her and getting to kiss her, it just- oh, God!
